newsitem.title: MALTA: Maltese-German fund management firm formed.
newsitem.headline: Maltese-German fund management firm formed.

text.p: Malta's Mid-Med Bank on Monday announced the setting up of Tri-Med Fund Management Ltd in association with the DWS Group of Germany and the tiny APS Bank of Malta.
Mid-Med chairman Norman Mifsud said the new company aimed to provide high a quality-range of investment fund products for investors in Malta.

"DWS's participation in Tri-Med signifies a capital injection exceeding Lm800,000 ($2.2 million) but more significantly, it will bring in the know-how of DWS's four decades of experience to all aspects of Tri-Med's operations," Mifsud said.

"DWS will also provide various key services, including processing of investors' records and transactions and investment advisory functions. In addition, Tri-Med will be utilising the custody services of Deutsche Bank," he said.
Mifsud said Tri-Med would offer a wide choice of funds to enable investors to balance risk with opportunity.
"Some funds will be primarily income oriented while others will aim for capital growth, concentrating their investment in equity markets," he added.
Tri-Med has committed capital resources of Lm 2 million. Mid-Med has a 49 percent stake in the company, the DWS Group has 41 percent and APS 10 percent.
Mid-Med is Malta's largest bank and the only one in which the government has a controlling stake. DWS is a subsidiary of Deutsche Bank. APS is a private bank. ($=0.36 Maltese lira)
